# Codlook — Software Company Based in Diyarbakır, Türkiye

> Codlook is a software company based in Diyarbakır, Türkiye. It builds corporate websites, e-commerce, custom software and business tracking systems, and it designed and built LOOK, its own programming language for the web, from the ground up. Codlook builds its own technology stack end to end — from the language and runtime to the applications its customers use.

## About Us

Codlook (legal name: Codlook Bilişim) is a software development company based in Diyarbakır, Türkiye, working with businesses on custom software, corporate web solutions, and tracking/automation systems that digitize everyday business processes. Our goal is to deliver sustainable, scalable solutions written from scratch for each customer's needs.

What sets Codlook apart is that we do not only use existing tools — **we build our own technology stack**. We designed our own programming language (LOOK), its runtime, its package system and its developer tooling from scratch.

## The LOOK Programming Language

LOOK is a modern programming language designed from scratch for server-side web development, shipped as a single self-contained (all-in-one) binary. It has its own bytecode virtual machine (VM) and built-in database support — MySQL/MariaDB and PostgreSQL (native wire protocol), embedded SQLite, and Redis (RESP2) for sessions and cache — plus WebSocket, Server-Sent Events, and an opt-in embedded mail server (SMTP; IMAP is experimental, read-only INBOX), all in one binary with minimal external runtime dependencies.

LOOK is an independent programming language built for the web, with its own engine, running in production. Designing a programming language is deep, multi-year engineering work: syntax, parser, compiler, virtual machine, standard library and toolchain. LOOK shows that Codlook does not just use software — it builds software at its most fundamental layer.

- [LOOK — Home](https://look.codlook.com/): The vision behind the language and a quick start.
- [LOOK Documentation](https://look.codlook.com/docs.html): Syntax, routing, databases, real-time features and the full language reference.
- [LOOK Packages](https://look.codlook.com/packages.html): Built-in modules and ecosystem packages.
- [LOOK Error Guide](https://look.codlook.com/errors.html): Error messages, their causes, and fixes with code examples.
- [LOOK guide for AI agents](https://look.codlook.com/llms.txt): Machine-readable documentation.

## Solutions and Services

- **Corporate websites** — modern, fast, easy-to-manage company websites.
- **E-commerce solutions** — product, order, payment and sales management.
- **Custom software development** — web and desktop applications written from scratch for each business.
- **Staff tracking system** — working hours, check-in/check-out, leave and staff management.
- **Carpet-cleaning tracking system** — order, delivery and process tracking for carpet-cleaning and service businesses.
- **Warehouse and inventory management** — warehouse, stock, inventory and shipment solutions.
- **Custom solutions for LOGO software** — integrations, reporting and custom development for LOGO ERP products.
- **Business tracking and automation systems** — web-based business applications that digitize workflows.
